relations.text: Brazeのエージェント用コンソールは、Google Geminiなどの基盤モデルに対応している
relations.text_en: Braze's agent console supports major foundation models such as Google Gemini

source.label: Braze 10-K
source.quote: The console supports major foundation models, like Google Gemini, Anthropic, and OpenAI, and encourages composability through cross-integration of AI features and the Braze Data Platform, as well as the embedding of agentic reasoning and content creation capabilities into the Canvas environment.

relations.text: BrazeはDatadogから、2026年1月期に約380万ドルのサービスを購入した
relations.text_en: Braze purchased services from Datadog in the aggregate amount of approximately $3.8 million during the fiscal year ended January 31, 2026

source.label: Braze 10-K
source.quote: We have purchased services from Datadog, Inc. in the aggregate amount of approximately $ 3.8 million during the fiscal year ended January 31, 2026, of which $ 0.1 million was included within accrued expenses and other current liabilities on the consolidated balance sheets.

relations.text: BrazeはSnowflakeとの提携により、Snowflakeのデータ共有でプラットフォーム内のデータを利用できる

source.label: Braze 10-K
source.quote: Alongside Braze Currents, data tracked and stored within our platform can also be accessed directly via our partnership with Snowflake using Snowflake’s Data Sharing mechanism.
